user.title: Connect to Famio
user.description: Address of the Famio server (e.g. 192.168.1.50 – HTTPS on port 8766 is used – or https://famio.example.org) and a Famio account. Home Assistant sees what this member sees; best create a separate account "Home Assistant".

certificate.title: Check the server's certificate
certificate.description:
{url} uses its own certificate. Compare the fingerprint with the server log (e.g. `journalctl -u famio` or `docker logs famio`) or the Famio app:

`{fingerprint}`

Only confirm if it matches.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Famio again
reauth_confirm.description: The session of {username} was ended (e.g. signed out in the app). Please enter the password again.

error.invalid_cert: The server's certificate does not match the confirmed fingerprint.

abort.already_configured: This Famio account is already connected.
